Content: It seems to me that advertising which many people find offensive is bad business.
Why advertise your product using such a theme?
This actually has nothing to do with cigarettes.
Personally I will make a point to avoid R. J. Reynold and Nabisco products simply because I have had my intelligence insulted by this advertisement.
With such creative people in the advertising business why pay good money for a controversial advertisement when there are so many other options.
I am a male college student and am not at all impressed with this ad.
Please consider your audience and apologize your attack more reasonably.
